_comment: Actor Factory convention, not read by Apify. After each deploy the Publisher creates or updates these saved tasks through the Apify API and publishes those with "publish": true (factory/publisher/tasks.py). Task names: 3-63 characters, lower case, digits and hyphens. An Actor can have up to 10 published tasks.

tasks.name: daily-new-tech-jobs
tasks.title: Daily new jobs at top tech companies
tasks.description: Every job newly posted at Airbnb, Stripe, Discord, Zoox, Spotify, Notion, Ramp, Warp, Hugging Face, Blueground, ottonova and tado, across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable and Personio. Schedule it daily: each run returns only jobs that are new since the last run.
